auth_details: Free tier requires no API key (non-commercial only). Pro tier uses API key via path or query parameter after paid signup.
free_tier_limits: 45 requests per minute from an IP (non-commercial use only); HTTPS not available on free tier
paid_plans: Pro plans available for commercial use with HTTPS, higher rate limits, and bulk endpoints
rate_limits: Free: 45 requests per minute per IP. Pro/Enterprise: unlimited (subject to Acceptable Use Policy).
description: ip-api provides free and paid IP geolocation lookups returning country, region, city, coordinates, ISP, timezone, and related network data. Non-commercial use has a free HTTP endpoint with rate limits; commercial use requires a paid Pro plan with HTTPS and higher limits.
resolution_notes: Pending live verification of auth field dispute (API key path vs query, Pro host).
